license_required.quote: The board shall register an applicant to become a registered interior designer, and to use the title of registered interior designer in the State of Alabama, only if the applicant satisfies all of the following requirements

exams.name: NCIDQ Examination
exams.notes: Applicants must pass the NCIDQ examination. Architects satisfying NCIDQ eligibility requirements may also take the exam.
exams.quote: The applicant has successfully passed the NCIDQ examination.

interval_years.quote: Certificates of registration shall expire on September 30 of each year, and shall become invalid on October 1 of each year, unless renewed.

required.quote: Submission of proof, on forms approved by the board, of compliance with all continuing education requirements established by the board.

available.quote: The board may waive the requirements for registration and grant registration to any applicant who submits proof of current registration as an interior designer in another state, the District of Columbia, or a territory of the United States that requires standards for registration which are substantially equivalent to those required in this state and gives similar reciprocity to registered interior designers of this state.

requirements.value: Proof of current registration in another state/DC/territory with substantially equivalent standards, and that jurisdiction must give similar reciprocity to Alabama registrants.
requirements.quote: submits proof of current registration as an interior designer in another state, the District of Columbia, or a territory of the United States that requires standards for registration which are substantially equivalent to those required in this state and gives similar reciprocity to registered interior designers of this state.

exists.quote: There is created the Alabama Board for Registered Interior Designers, to be comprised of seven members appointed by the Governor

national_certification.value: National Council for Interior Design Qualification (NCIDQ)
national_certification.quote: NCIDQ. The National Council for Interior Design Qualification.

regulatory_model.quote: this chapter is not intended to restrict the practice of interior design or the use of the terms design, designer, interior design, or interior designer in this state

credential_type.quote: The board shall register an applicant to become a registered interior designer, and to use the title of registered interior designer in the State of Alabama

is_mandatory.quote: this chapter is not intended to restrict the practice of interior design or the use of the terms design, designer, interior design, or interior designer in this state

title_protection.quote: Any person who is not a registered interior designer who uses the title registered interior designer on any sign, card, listing, advertising, business name, stationery, or in any other manner knowingly implies or indicates that he or she is a registered interior designer shall be guilty of a Class A misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: Except as expressly provided in Section 34-15C-9, nothing in this chapter shall be interpreted to prohibit any person who is not a registered interior designer from conducting any activity not prohibited by any other state law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, dishonesty, or misrepresentation in the pursuit of practice or in obtaining a certificate of registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, dishonesty, or misrepresentation, whether knowing or unknowing, in the pursuit of his or her practice or in obtaining any certificate of registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, misconduct, or incompetence in the pursuit of practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence, misconduct, or incompetence in the pursuit of his or her practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, until civil rights are restored.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, until civil rights are restored.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetency as adjudged by a court having jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetency as adjudged by a court having jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or aiding/abetting a violation of the prohibited activities section.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or directly or indirectly aiding or abetting in a violation of Section 34-15C-9.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing in violation of standards of professional conduct established by board rule.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing in this state in violation of any standards of professional conduct as may be established by rule of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay any fee or fine assessed by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to pay any fee or fine assessed by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with any order of the board.

definition_quote.value: An interior design professional, as defined by the NCIDQ, who is approved and registered by the board and the Secretary of State.
definition_quote.quote: REGISTERED INTERIOR DESIGNER. An interior design professional, as defined by the NCIDQ, who is approved and registered by the board and the Secretary of State.

value: submit sealed, stamped drawings to building officials for commercial interior projects in spaces less than 5,000 contiguous square feet

interior construction excluding structural support, fire rated assemblies, stairwells, means of egress, elevators, plumbing, HVAC, fire protection, mechanical and electrical systems (unless incorporating documents by architects/engineers)

methods_authorized.quote: a registered interior designer may submit sealed, stamped drawings to building officials for a commercial interior project in any space of less than 5,000 contiguous square feet within a building of any size

credential_tier.quote: The board shall register an applicant to become a registered interior designer, and to use the title of registered interior designer in the State of Alabama

value: Satisfy all NCIDQ education and experience eligibility requirements

education_experience_pathways.quote: Has satisfied all requirements, including all education and experience requirements, for eligibility to take the NCIDQ examination; or Holds a degree from a National Architectural Accreditation Board (NAAB) accredited school and has met NCIDQ eligibility requirements to take the NCIDQ examination, or is a registered architect who satisfies NCIDQ eligibility requirements to take the NCIDQ examination.

nonstructural_scope_only.quote: the drawings may not include the design or modification of architectural and engineering interior construction relating to building systems, such as building structural support, fire rated assemblies, stairwells, means of egress components, elevators, elevator shafts, plumbing, heating, ventilation, air conditioning, fire protection, and mechanical and electrical systems

excluded_building_systems.quote: the drawings may not include the design or modification of architectural and engineering interior construction relating to building systems, such as building structural support, fire rated assemblies, stairwells, means of egress components, elevators, elevator shafts, plumbing, heating, ventilation, air conditioning, fire protection, and mechanical and electrical systems

square_footage_limit.quote: a registered interior designer may submit sealed, stamped drawings to building officials for a commercial interior project in any space of less than 5,000 contiguous square feet within a building of any size

residential_practice_exempt.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be interpreted to prohibit any person from making plans and specifications for or administering the erection, enlargement, or alteration of any building upon any farm for the use of any farmer, any single family residence of any size

interior_decorator_exemption.quote: this chapter is not intended to restrict the practice of interior design or the use of the terms design, designer, interior design, or interior designer in this state

permit_submission_authority.quote: a registered interior designer may submit sealed, stamped drawings to building officials for a commercial interior project in any space of less than 5,000 contiguous square feet within a building of any size

seal_required.quote: A registered interior designer shall obtain a seal bearing the name of the registered interior designer, a design authorized by the board, the legend Registered Interior Designer, the words State of Alabama, and the registration number of the registered interior designer.

responsible_control_defined.quote: Any registered interior designer who stamps or allows to be stamped any document that is not prepared under his or her supervision and control shall be guilty of a Class A misdemeanor.

compensation_disclosure_required.quote: a registered interior designer may receive a fee or commission for the sale or the supervision of installation of personal property or fixtures, but may not receive both a fee and a commission without the express consent of the client.

conflict_of_interest_rules.quote: The registered interior designer shall attempt to avoid all conflicts of interest with a client or employer. If a conflict of interest is unavoidable, the registered interior designer shall immediately inform the client or employer of any business association, interest, or circumstance which may influence the professional judgment

business_entity_practice_permitted.quote: It shall be lawful for any person registered pursuant to this chapter to participate as owners with architects or professional engineers, or both, in partnerships, corporations, professional corporations, professional associations, and other business entity relationships.

inactive_status_available.quote: Adopt rules providing for a registered interior designer to be classified as inactive and to avoid the payment of annual fees, so long as the inactive registered interior designer does not use the titles, stamps, or seals restricted by subsection (a) or subsection (b) of Section 34-15C-9 during inactive status.
